llm_response.reason: Multiple scam characteristics are present: 1) The claim of zero fees and guaranteed deposit protection is highly aggressive and unrealistic. 2) The website references registration via a generic FinCEN search tool rather than direct, verifiable documentation, typical of false legitimacy claims. 3) The domain was registered less than a month ago, which is highly unusual for a supposed global exchange managing massive assets. 4) All WHOIS information is redacted, further reducing legitimacy. 5) The privacy statement is ambiguous, and the contact info is generic and non-compliant for serious financial services (just an email; no company address, phone, etc.). 6) There is no evidence of verified endorsements, real leadership, or genuine regulatory licensing. Altogether, these strongly match the defined profile of a cryptocurrency scam website.
